# ✨ Skyblock: But Better

> The most optimised and feature-rich modpack for Hypixel Skyblock — performance, functionality, and ease of use, all in one place.

---

## 🎯 What is Skyblock: But Better?

**Skyblock: But Better** is a carefully curated Fabric modpack built exclusively for **Hypixel Skyblock**. Every mod has been hand-picked to serve a clear purpose — no bloat, no filler.

Whether you're a brand-new player or a seasoned veteran grinding the late game, this modpack gives you everything you need to play smarter, faster, and better.

---

## ⚡ Why Skyblock: But Better?

### 🚀 Performance First
Powered by **Sodium**, **ImmediatelyFast**, **BadOptimizations**, and **Entity Culling**, this pack is built to run smoothly even on lower-end hardware — without sacrificing any features.

### 🛠️ Feature Rich
Includes essential Skyblock tools like **Skyblocker**, **Skyblock Tweaks**, **Firmament**, **SkyHanni**, and **Skytils** — giving you overlays, dungeon helpers, item info, and much more, all preconfigured.

### 🎨 Polished Visuals
Ships with the **FurfSky Reborn** resource pack and **FullBright** for a visually enhanced Skyblock experience out of the box.

### 🧩 Easy to Use
A clean **Mod Menu**, **YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)**, and sensible defaults mean you can jump straight in — no hours spent configuring mods.

---

## 📦 Included Mods

| Category | Mods |
|---|---|
| **Performance** | Sodium, ImmediatelyFast, BadOptimizations, Entity Culling, More Culling |
| **Skyblock Features** | Skyblocker, Skyblock Tweaks, Firmament, SkyHanni, Skytils |
| **QoL & UI** | Mod Menu, YACL, Zoomify, Great Scrollable Tooltips, Chat Patches |
| **Visuals** | FurfSky Reborn, Default Dark Mode, Wavy Capes |
| **Utility** | Cloth Config, FabricCore, Fabric Language Kotlin, Text Placeholder API |
